content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

What is the FY2026 revenue outlook by company: actuals to date plus the forecast?

content.statement:
WITH __forecast AS (
  SELECT
    year_month AS fc_year_month,
    scope_name,
    series,
    value_type,
    revenue_inr AS fc_revenue_inr,
    lower_bound_inr,
    upper_bound_inr
  FROM WIPRO_FINANCE_360_APP.APP_DATA.V_AGENT_FORECAST
)
SELECT
  scope_name AS company,
  SUM(IFF(value_type = 'ACTUAL', fc_revenue_inr, 0)) AS actual_jan_jul_inr,
  SUM(IFF(value_type = 'FORECAST', fc_revenue_inr, 0)) AS forecast_aug_dec_inr,
  SUM(fc_revenue_inr) AS fy2026_outlook_inr,
  SUM(IFF(value_type = 'FORECAST', lower_bound_inr, 0)) AS forecast_low_inr,
  SUM(IFF(value_type = 'FORECAST', upper_bound_inr, 0)) AS forecast_high_inr
FROM __forecast
WHERE
  series <> 'GROUP' AND fc_year_month BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-01'
GROUP BY
  scope_name
ORDER BY
  fy2026_outlook_inr DESC
 -- Generated by Cortex Analyst (request_id: 883d0940-ed39-467b-ab71-577e1e83f9d5)
;
